description: A bounded, acyclic build and evidence-led repair plan for the host coding agent.

policy.pass: The requested behavior and final state work, relevant tests and unchanged meaningful contracts pass, and the host has viewed actual recorded intermediate frames and required viewport/reduced-motion variants.
policy.repair_needed: An observed defect has a specific, testable source hypothesis and a narrow repair is already authorized by the user's build/fix scope.
policy.blocked: A concrete environment, permission, evidence or reproduction blocker prevents a justified next step. Missing evidence is not a pass. Inconclusive evidence with no justified repair is a blocker.
policy.unresolved: A defect remains after the second repair/retest pair. Stop with the remaining failure and evidence; do not start a third repair.
policy.comparison: Keep the original capture and every subsequent capture ID. Retest the same recipe, contracts, viewport and reduced-motion setting; inspect after frames and compare against the original baseline without loosening expectations.
policy.authority: The host edits only authorized source. The graph grants no installation, credential, publication, production or unrelated action permissions. Stop and report when required permission is absent.
policy.boundedness: Execute each selected graph node once. Repetition is represented by a distinct numbered node, never an edge back to an earlier node. A new plan after a terminal report is outside this graph.

nodes.label: Brief
steps: Read the user's request, repository instructions and existing stack; record scope and authorized local interaction.
Fix the primary behavior, intended visual result, final state and required test variants before implementation.

nodes.label: Design
steps: Choose one visual direction consistent with the requested product and existing design system.
For spatial UI, select a renderer that actually supports the requested depth and motion; define accessible controls and reduced-motion behavior.

nodes.label: Build
steps: Implement the first usable version with real controls and states; start its trusted credential-free loopback preview.
Check compilation, console errors and principal behavior. Record a concrete blocker if preview or evidence tools cannot run.

nodes.label: Inspect
steps: Record ordinary use and a relevant interruption/reversal with motion_capture using fixed, meaningful expectations; retain original capture IDs.
Use motion_inspect on a bounded finding window and view actual motion_frames intermediate images, including internal canvas/3D motion when relevant.
Check required desktop, narrow and reduced-motion variants. Classify as pass, justified repair_needed or blocked; do not infer causality from cancellation or app annotations alone.

nodes.label: Repair 1
steps: Connect the observed defect to a testable source hypothesis and apply the smallest authorized repair through the host's coding tools.
Preserve the requested feature and original evidence; do not copy a prewritten reference fix or weaken the expectations.

nodes.label: Verify 1
steps: Rerun relevant tests and motion_capture for the same interaction, contracts and required variants; preserve all new capture IDs.
Call motion_compare against the original baseline, inspect bounded after windows and view actual after frames; verify the intended final state.
Classify as pass, another justified repair_needed or blocked.

nodes.label: Repair 2
steps: Use the remaining observed failure and source evidence to apply a second narrow authorized repair.
Keep the original feature, expectations and all captures; this is the final repair attempt in this graph.

nodes.label: Verify 2
steps: Retest the same interaction and variants, rerun relevant tests, compare with the original capture and view after frames; retain every capture ID.
Classify as pass, unresolved remaining defect or blocked. Do not add another repair/retest pair.

nodes.label: Report
steps: Deliver the product/preview, principal behavior, evidence-led changes, test results and all before/after capture IDs or paths.
State passed only when the pass policy is met; otherwise report the unresolved defect after the bound and any limits without claiming completion.

nodes.label: Blocked report
steps: Report the exact blocked action, target and reason, available evidence and completed checks.
Request only the permission or environment change actually needed; label missing motion evidence and do not manufacture a passing result.
